title: End-to-End E-Commerce Analytics with Microsoft Fabric (Medallion + Dimensional Model)
evaluates: DE: incremental ingestion with Data Factory (Lookup + ForEach + Copy Data + watermark upsert) into Bronze
DE: Lakehouse / OneLake medallion architecture (Bronze / Silver / Gold)
DE: Spark/PySpark Silver layer cleansing, window-function dedup and Delta MERGE upsert
DE: Gold layer dimensional modeling (dim_customer, dim_date with fiscal calendar, fact sales)
DA: semantic model design over the Gold layer
DA: Power BI sales dashboard and time-intelligence reporting (YoY, monthly/seasonal, period comparison)
requirements: Microsoft Fabric workspace (Lakehouse + Data Factory + Power BI enabled)
OLTP source seeded via prep/set_up_oltp.sql with the provided customers/locations/products/sales CSVs
control/metadata table driving the ForEach incremental copy
Spark notebooks attached to the Lakehouse (silver_layer_notebook, gold_layer_notebook)
Power BI semantic model bound to the Gold Lakehouse tables

preview: A genuine end-to-end e-commerce data solution on Microsoft Fabric: Data Factory copies only new/changed records into Bronze using a watermark pattern, PySpark notebooks build the Silver (dedup + Delta MERGE upsert) and Gold (dim_customer, fiscal dim_date, fact sales) layers in the Lakehouse/OneLake, a semantic model sits on top, and Power BI delivers Sales and Time-Intelligence dashboards.
portfolio_value: Covers both DE and DA roles in one cohesive Fabric build - incremental pipeline engineering, medallion Lakehouse, Spark dimensional modeling, semantic model and Power BI reporting - the canonical Fabric analytics-engineer narrative on a recognizable retail/e-commerce rubric.
notes: Authentic E2E take-home-style project (not a tutorial mirror). Silver notebook does SCD-style dedup with Window.partitionBy + Delta MERGE; Gold builds a fiscal-year date dimension and customer dimension. Roles DE + DA, no ML. Branch main (verified via git). Images of the pipeline and dashboards included under images/.
